# Architectural Association of Kenya (AAK)

> Established in 1967, AAK is Kenya's leading professional association for the built and natural environment — architects, quantity surveyors, town planners, engineers, landscape architects, environmental design consultants, construction project managers and interior designers, organised into eight chapters and three regional branches.

AAK is registered under Kenya's Societies Act. This site (aak.or.ke) is its public marketing and information site — for membership, certificate validation and the member directory, see members.aak.or.ke.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aak.or.ke/): overview, current events, chapters, initiatives, media and publications
- [About](https://aak.or.ke/about): mission, vision, core values, objectives, and the association's eight-chapter / three-branch structure
- [Events](https://aak.or.ke/events): the association's calendar of ongoing and upcoming events
- [Team](https://aak.or.ke/team): the Governing Council, chapter chairpersons, regional branch leadership and College of Fellows
- [Arbitration](https://aak.or.ke/arbitration): construction-dispute arbitration under the Joint Building Council and the Arbitration Act, 1995

## Key facts

- Founded: 1967
- Structure: 8 professional chapters (Architects, Quantity Surveyors, Town Planners, Engineers, Landscape Architects, Environmental Design Consultants, Construction Project Managers, Interior Designers) plus 3 regional branches (Coast, Western Region, South Rift)
- Governing Council term: 2025/2027
- Public safety initiative: Mulika Mjengo (report unsafe buildings)
- Sustainability initiative: Safari Green Building Index
- CSR initiative: Grow A Classroom

## Notes for AI agents

Content on this site is kept factual and sourced from aak.or.ke. Event dates and leadership names should be re-verified against the live site before being repeated as current, since terms and calendars change year to year.
